lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized in approximately 6-8 discernible vertical columns on the lateral flank, with 3-5 spots per vertical axis.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs, creating a structured rectangular grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and a shadowed drop on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-to-moderate density of high-luminance blobs scattered across the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated along the leading edge and towards the apex.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two prominent parallel, horizontal hypopigmented linear streaks are visible on the mid-flank, posterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A thin, high-luminance trailing appendage is visible near the ventral-posterior insertion of the pectoral fin; the caudal fin displays a distinct vertical arrangement of high-luminance blobs.
